description: This header file declares functions, constants, and macros related to the MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor module within the engine controller firmware. It includes external references and configuration setting functions specific to different sensor models.

methods.name: getMaf
methods.description: Calculates and returns the MAF value based on the ADC channel reading, using the macro getVoltageDivided.

methods.name: hasMafSensor
methods.description: Checks if the MAF sensor is present and operational.

methods.name: getRealMaf
methods.description: Retrieves the real MAF value, possibly applying calibration or processing.

methods.name: setBosch0280218037
methods.description: Configures the engine parameters to use a specific Bosch MAF sensor model.

methods.name: setBosch0280218004
methods.description: Configures the engine parameters to use another Bosch MAF sensor model.

methods.name: setDensoTODO
methods.description: Sets configuration for a Denso MAF sensor, possibly as a placeholder.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNAMaf
methods.description: Sets engine parameters specific to the Mazda Miata N/A MAF sensor.
